integrity: The full prime-power statement is proved symbolically from standard distance-regular parameters. Computational checks verify eight field-order recurrences and the complete binary rank-four geometry; they are not infinite-family proofs. No claim of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Rank-four symplectic dual polar spaces only; no generalization to all polar families or ranks; no primitive multiplicity classification; residual literature-priority risk.
title: Sharp negative-type exponent of the rank-four symplectic dual polar metric
